diagnostics.help: Upgrade Next.js to 15.5.18 (or newer). Next.js bundles its own React Server Components runtime, so bumping Next.js  not `react`  ships the fix. Run `npm install next@15.5.18`. See https://vercel.com/changelog/next-js-may-2026-security-release
